name: font-picker
title: FontPicker
description: Google Fonts families picked the way a design tool picks them: a searchable, category-filtered list of the most popular families (the kit's CommandMenu, virtualized), each drawn in its own face (only its name's glyphs are fetched, only while on screen), that previews the highlighted family on your text. FontPicker holds one family (a root, its trigger and its popup), FontStackPicker a font stack (a root, its field of chips and its popup) as chips you reorder by their handle (drag, or Space and the arrows) or remove, FontList is the list alone; useGoogleFont and fontStack load and set a family without a picker.
